response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, sf.traitcount, s.entrystat FROM scanfeatures sf INNER JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(traitcount) as avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM filtered GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat), totaled AS (SELECT *, (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM grouped) as total_records FROM grouped) SELECT zoneref, entrystat, avg_traitcount, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / total_records as fraction FROM totaled WHERE total_records > 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: NULLS LAST sorting syntax is supported by the database (standard in PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server 2012+; requires workarounds in MySQL)
